welcome: Welcome to the Story Repair Shop! Choose a storybook.
mode-repair: Mend the Story. Listen, then find what makes sense.
mode-silly: Wild Endings. Listen, then choose the wonderfully impossible ending.
open-repair: Tap the torn paper to open the Repair Shop.
drag-piece: Choose a painted piece. Drag it to the torn spot, or tap the piece and then tap the spot.
retry-repair: That makes a different story. Listen once more and find what helps.
retry-silly: That could really happen! Can you find the wonderfully wild ending?
idle-repeat: Let’s hear the story once more.
idle-model: The golden glow shows where the repair belongs.
next-page: Turn the page for the next story.
mode-complete: Three stories repaired! Your storybook is shining.
all-complete: You repaired every kind of story. Wonderful storytelling!
fox-bridge-setup: Fia Fox wants to visit her friend across the stream. The path stops at the water. What could help Fia cross?
fox-bridge-success: A bridge joins the path. Now Fia can visit her friend!
nia-sunflower-setup: Nia planted a tiny seed. She gave it water and sunshine every day. What grew next?
nia-sunflower-success: A bright sunflower grew from Nia’s tiny seed!
leo-umbrella-setup: Leo was walking home when raindrops began to fall. What could help Leo stay dry?
leo-umbrella-success: Leo opened the umbrella and stayed cozy and dry!
fish-bicycle-setup: Finn Fish swam around his bowl. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?
fish-bicycle-success: Finn zoomed away on a tiny bicycle. What a wonderfully wild story!
dragon-trumpet-setup: Dara Dragon put on pajamas and yawned. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?
dragon-trumpet-success: Dara played a trumpet while roller-skating to bed. So silly!
bear-moon-soup-setup: Milo Bear set the table for supper. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?
bear-moon-soup-success: The moon came down for soup with Milo. A deliciously wild ending!
